record.claim_text: Patagonia donates 100% of its sales to environmental groups.
record.subject: Patagonia sales donation claim
record.summary: Source 1 says Patagonia has committed 1% of total sales to environmental groups since 1985. That directly contradicts the claim that it donates 100% of its sales.

record.claim_text: Patagonia commits 1% of its total sales to environmental groups.
record.subject: Patagonia 1% for the Planet
record.summary: Source 1 directly supports the claim, stating that since 1985, Patagonia has committed 1% of its total sales to environmental groups through One Percent for the Planet.
